title: Android Process Analyzer dump (schema_version 3.0-dump)
description: <pid>_pid_analyze_dump.json: one file per capture session. It holds the full analyzer report (validated by schemas/analyzer-report.schema.json) and every raw evidence file captured from the device, inline. Each evidence item keeps the exact adb command, exit code, byte count and SHA-256 of the raw bytes. The content field is the UTF-8 decoding of those bytes, with invalid sequences replaced; the SHA-256 identifies the raw bytes.

analyzer_repo_commit.description: Git commit of the analyzer used for the capture; null if git was unavailable.

report.description: The analyzer report. Same structure as the output of AndroidProcessAnalyzer.py analyze --format json.
